statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The post-close NQ rebound has carried delayed futures back near prior settlement, so current evidence does not show a persistent no-retracement path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is back in the low band after substantial mean reversion, while rates, oil, geopolitical uncertainty and the September 24 U.S. release/opening cluster keep Stress extreme.
headline: NQ mean reversion lowers Tail to low while rates, oil and geopolitics keep Stress extreme
body: Delayed NQ is near 31,010, close to prior settlement after a cash-session decline that pushed the Nasdaq down 1.13%. The 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest since 2007, Brent settled at $103.08, and Iran-U.S. tensions remain unresolved. Fresh Finviz breadth is weak but is used only as supplementary confirmation.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hourly slots, Tail was low overnight and before the U.S. open, rose from WATCH to elevated during the rates-led cash selloff, peaked at 34% at 17:00 UTC, then eased through the close and post-close rebound to 23% by 21:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is back in the low band after substantial mean reversion. The next concentrated conditional danger window is 12:30-15:15 UTC on September 24 around U.S. data, Beth Hammack remarks and the cash open; elevated Tail requires observed persistence or failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is around 31,010, near prior settlement after a deep cash-session selloff and substantial rebound. That mean reversion argues against an active no-retracement path, while high yields, $100-plus Brent and Middle East uncertainty keep Stress extreme.
drivers: NQ has rebounded materially from the U.S. afternoon low
10-year Treasury yield ended above 5%
Brent settled above $103 after a near-4% rise
Fresh Finviz breadth remains weak in semiconductors and megacaps
